svg.title: Customer Health Discovery and Solution Design Master Diagram
svg.desc: A consolidated diagram covering the business canvas, process flow, functional architecture, integrations, swimlane responsibilities, application design, PRD requirements, and AI agent graph for the Customer Health project.

text.tspan: Customer Health Discovery and Solution Design
Complete discovery artifact map: business canvas, workflow, architecture, integrations,
roles, application design, PRD, and AI-assisted agent graph.
Core cycle: updates and feedback feed health scoring, alerts, acknowledgement, reporting, and the next monitoring loop.
Score = progress 28% + team performance 24% + client satisfaction 22% + delivery confidence 26% - risk penalty
Own health, risk response, timelines, stakeholders
Add implementation progress and issue notes
Review summary and submit satisfaction feedback
Enforce access, score health, surface alerts
Information architecture and role-based product surface
Actor, Project, Timeline, Ownership, Risk model, Acknowledgement, Session
Human review remains the approval point before escalation, notification, or client-facing communication.

svg.text: Prepared for the Customer Health discovery and solution design process. Source: docs/discovery/customer-health-discovery-artifacts.md
